steps.migration_guide: Update <TargetFramework> in .csproj to net10.0. Run 'dotnet restore' afterwards. Check https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/compatibility for breaking changes.
steps.wiki_reference: [start from these base images for build-env if Token is not required](https://dev.azure.com/inmar/Finance/_wiki/wikis/65fc2eb0-7cc9-4068-8560-cf788f4c6d8f?pagePath=/Finance%20IT/Code%20and%20Development%20Guidelines/Docker%20best%20practices%20and%20sample%20Dockerfiles)

steps.migration_guide: Add <Nullable>enable</Nullable> in .csproj. Fix CS8600/CS8602/CS8603 warnings. Add '?' to nullable parameters. Use null-forgiving '!' operator where safe.

steps.description: LangVersion not set to 14 or latest
steps.migration_guide: Add <LangVersion>14</LangVersion> in .csproj <PropertyGroup>. C# 14 enables extension members, first-class Span, field keyword, and more.
Migrate from Newtonsoft.Json to System.Text.Json. Replace JsonConvert with JsonSerializer. Replace [JsonProperty] with [JsonPropertyName]. Use source generators for AOT.

steps.description: No global.json found to pin SDK version
steps.migration_guide: Create global.json in repo root: run 'dotnet new globaljson --sdk-version 10.0.100'. This pins the SDK for all developers and CI.
steps.wiki_reference: [start from these base images for build-env if Token is not required](https://dev.azure.com/inmar/Finance/_wiki/wikis/65fc2eb0-7cc9-4068-8560-cf788f4c6d8f?pagePath=/Finance%20IT/Code%20and%20Development%20Guidelines/Docker%20best%20practices%20and%20sample%20Dockerfiles)

steps.migration_guide: Add <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings> in .csproj. Remove now-implicit usings (System, System.Linq, etc.). Add custom global usings in GlobalUsings.cs.

Create Directory.Packages.props at solution root with <ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>true</ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>. Move all Version= attributes from .csproj PackageReference to central file.
Add <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors> in .csproj. Fix all existing warnings first. Suppress specific warnings with <NoWarn>CS1591</NoWarn> if needed.
Migrate controllers to minimal APIs: app.MapGet("/api/users", (IService svc) => svc.GetAll()). Group with MapGroup("/api/users"). Add .WithTags() for Swagger.
Add health checks: builder.Services.AddHealthChecks().AddDbContextCheck<AppDbContext>(); app.MapHealthChecks("/health");. Add liveness/readiness for K8s.

steps.description: Not configured for Native AOT publishing
steps.migration_guide: Add <PublishAot>true</PublishAot> in .csproj. Ensure no runtime reflection. Use source generators for serialization. Test with 'dotnet publish -r linux-x64'. .NET 10 improves AOT significantly.
Add <PublishTrimmed>true</PublishTrimmed> in .csproj. Fix trimming warnings with [DynamicallyAccessedMembers]. Test thoroughly. Use <TrimMode>link</TrimMode> for aggressive trimming.

steps.description: No RuntimeIdentifier specified in project file
steps.migration_guide: Add <RuntimeIdentifier>linux-x64</RuntimeIdentifier> (or win-x64, linux-arm64) inside <PropertyGroup> in .csproj for predictable deployment builds.
steps.wiki_reference: [start from these base images for build-env if Token is not required](https://dev.azure.com/inmar/Finance/_wiki/wikis/65fc2eb0-7cc9-4068-8560-cf788f4c6d8f?pagePath=/Finance%20IT/Code%20and%20Development%20Guidelines/Docker%20best%20practices%20and%20sample%20Dockerfiles)

steps.migration_guide: Use Span<T>/ReadOnlySpan<char> for zero-allocation parsing. Replace Substring() with AsSpan(). C# 14 adds first-class Span support in more contexts.

steps.suggested_fix: public record UserDto(string Name, string Email);
steps.migration_guide: Use record types for DTOs: 'public record UserDto(string Name, string Email);'. Provides value equality, immutability, with-expressions. Use 'record struct' for small stack types.
Convert 'namespace X { ... }' to 'namespace X;' (C# 10+). Removes one indentation level. Use IDE Quick Actions (Ctrl+.) to convert automatically.

steps.suggested_fix: public class MyService(ILogger<MyService> logger, IRepository repo)
steps.migration_guide: Use primary constructors (C# 12+): 'public class OrderService(ILogger logger)' instead of separate constructor + field. Best for DI services.

steps.description: No source generator usage for JSON serialization
steps.migration_guide: Create a JsonSerializerContext with [JsonSerializable(typeof(MyDto))] for AOT-safe serialization. Register via ConfigureHttpJsonOptions in ASP.NET.
Add output caching (.NET 7+): builder.Services.AddOutputCache(); app.UseOutputCache(); app.MapGet(...).CacheOutput();. Use cache tags for invalidation.
